SELECT msg_blocage FROM blockage.blockage_prod
WHERE DATE(create_time) = '{{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}';

select * from sage_blocages
where status= 0 and nb_envois>=21

WITH BR_UNIQUES AS (
    -- On ne garde ICI que les BR qui n'ont PAS de retour ET qui ne sont PAS encore facturés
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        DP.XFACT_0, 
        DD.XNRCP_0, 
        DD.XMNTRCP_0
    FROM BASE1.XDEPFAD DD
    INNER JOIN BASE1.XDEPFACT DP ON DD.XNUM_0 = DP.XNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN BASE1.PRETURND N ON N.PTHNUM_0 = DD.XNRCP_0
    LEFT JOIN BASE1.PINVOICED P ON P.NUMORI_0 = DD.XNRCP_0 -- Ajout de la jointure ici
    WHERE N.PTHNUM_0 IS NULL 
      AND P.NUM_0 IS NULL -- EXCLUT le BR s'il est déjà facturé dans Sage
),
TOTAL_FACTURE AS (
    -- La somme ne se fera plus que sur les BR "restants" / non facturés
    SELECT 
        XFACT_0,
        SUM(XMNTRCP_0) AS Total_BR_Non_Factures
    FROM BR_UNIQUES
    GROUP BY XFACT_0
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    DP.XCODF_0 AS CODE_FRNS,
    BP.BPRNAM_0 AS Raison,
    BP.XCPT_0 AS Comptable,
    ITM.XACH_0 AS Acheteur,
    DD.XNUM_0 AS N_Depot,
    DP.XMNT_0 AS Mnt_Facture,
    DP.XCMD_0 AS BC,
    DP.XMNTCMD_0 AS MontantBC,
    DD.XNRCP_0 AS Bon_Reception,
    DP.XFACT_0 AS FactureFrns,
    FORMAT(DP.XDATF_0, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS DateFacture,
    
    -- Montant du BR actuel affiché
    DD.XMNTRCP_0 AS Montant_Net_Par_BR,

    -- Somme UNIQUEMENT des BR restants (ici, s'il n'y en a qu'un seul, ce montant sera égal à Montant_Net_Par_BR)
    ISNULL(TF.Total_BR_Non_Factures, 0) AS SOME_BR_F,

    -- Écart calculé uniquement sur le reste à facturer
    (DP.XMNT_0 - ISNULL(TF.Total_BR_Non_Factures, 0)) AS Ecart_Global

FROM BASE1.XDEPFAD DD
INNER JOIN BASE1.XDEPFACT DP ON DD.XNUM_0 = DP.XNUM_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.BPARTNER BP ON DP.XCODF_0 = BP.BPRNUM_0
LEFT JOIN TOTAL_FACTURE TF ON TF.XFACT_0 = DP.XFACT_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PORDER PO ON PO.POHNUM_0 = DP.XCMD_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PORDERQ POD ON POD.POHNUM_0 = PO.POHNUM_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0=POD.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PINVOICED P ON P.NUMORI_0 = DD.XNRCP_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PRECEIPT PR ON PR.PTHNUM_0 = DD.XNRCP_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PRETURND N_FILTER ON N_FILTER.PTHNUM_0 = DD.XNRCP_0

WHERE DD.XNRCP_0 <> ''
  AND P.NUM_0 IS NULL          -- Filtre affichage principal
  AND PR.XRETINT_0 <> 2        -- Filtre affichage principal
  AND N_FILTER.PTHNUM_0 IS NULL -- Filtre affichage principal
  AND DP.XFACT_0 <> ''
  AND DP.XFACT_0 = '{{ $json.numero_facture }}'


ORDER BY DD.XNRCP_0
